out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed staff member use the hand sink next to the 3 compartment sink to add water to a container of cleaning product
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO ONLY USE THE HAND SINK FOR HAND WASHING. STAFF MEMBER MOVED TO THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The food probe thermometer was found out of calibration
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. MANAGEMENT ORDERED NEW FOOD PROBE THERMOMETERS DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed tongs being stored in a bucket of sanitizer solution
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO NOT STORE UTENSILS IN SANITIZER. STORE TONGS IN A DRY CONTAINER. USE TWO DIFFERENT COLOR TONGS FOR ALLERGENS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: Heat sensitive test strips or high temperature dish plate was not available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. MANAGEMENT ORDERED A HEAT SENSITIVE TEST STRIPS DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Observed no quaternary ammonia test kit on site.
violations.corrective_action: MANAGEMENT ORDERED QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT DURING THE INSPECTION

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: A written vomit and diarrhea clean up policy was not observed on site.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS GAVE PIC A COPY OF FAIRFAX COUNTY’S VOMIT AND DIARRHEA CLEAN UP POLICY.
